reviews.review:
The good: It is a game with Attractive characters that somehow managed to launch in this age of gay r - tards attempting to destroy gaming. 

The Bad: Uninspired gameplay that presents no real challenge or interesting mechanics at all for that matter. It "feels" like some kind of upscaled mobile game. You run around and shoot things with no skill expression in the same zones endlessly.
The devs realized they couldn't compete with D2 and Warframe as an actual video game and chose to be a gooner game instead. They lost that category to Warframe too lol.

My new updated negative review:
I had to leave to work all the way on the other side of the country since mid June, and came back on September 17. A lot of really hot bikini outfits were added in during this time, but were also taken out before I came back.
Back in February, they released a bunch of bikini outfits(I bought all of them immediately). Those outfits were still in the in game shop when I left for work in mid June.

So now because I was out making money so I can spend on all these super hot bikini outfits, Nexxon decides to stab me in the back by removing the summer skins(again) before I get back from work. I'm done with all this fomo. I refuse to play this game any longer while having to watch other players run in around in outfits that I would of bought if given the chance... I went a whole year raging over not being able to get the viessa and valby summer skins from 2024, and now they want me to go another year raging over these new skins. I decided to uninstall this game until Nexxon decides to stop pushing fomo tactics, and just let people buy every skin ever made at any given time.

My positive review before updating with negative review: 
Grinding is the content. And grinding is meant to be enjoyed with some quality eye candy.

Fun game, when you first start just know that level does not mean power, your reactors, weapons, and mods are the main source of power. once you get through the story mode it becomes much easier. The game makes you feel like a powerhouse.
